construction_frozen.lineup_value: phase0/bt_nhl_nhl_boxel.py lineup_pass (round-1 spec, unchanged): GSL = 0.75 G + 0.65 A + 0.075 SOG + 0.05 BLK - 0.075 PIM per skater-game; per-player decayed sums (0.99 per game, x0.8 at season boundaries) carried across teams and seasons; v = (S + mu*T0)/(T + T0), T0 = 10 h; mu = walk-forward position mean (entrants: walk-forward entrant pool from completed seasons); m = EWMA(0.8) of own prior TOI; L = sum over TONIGHT'S DRESSED SKATERS (box-score list) of (v - vbar_pos) m / 60; Ltil = L / walk-forward sd of team-game L.
construction_frozen.goalie_level: phase0/bt_nhl_gmar_gl.py gl_elo(mode='new') G_h/G_a for tonight's first-shot starter (bt_nhl_anatomy_build.load_starters); never win_goalie, never a max-shots starter.
construction_frozen.elo: phase0/bt_nhl_nhl_boxel.py elo_cell: E = (R_h + beta Ltil_h + gamma G_h + 30) - (R_a + beta Ltil_a + gamma G_a); shipped k 8 / ha 30 / regress 0.30, not re-tuned; logit of this probability replaces blend column 1; rest_diff, b2b_home, b2b_away, xg_diff unchanged; blend refit per fold.
construction_frozen.cell_selection: nested: for each outer season, the cell with the lowest n-weighted inner-LOSO pair loss over the other six seasons (round-1 Evaluator.nested)

arms.P_PRIMARY: lineup sum L AND starting-goalie level G, both INSIDE the W/L Elo (round-1 C3); (beta, gamma) nested over the full 5 x 4 grid.
arms.A2_L_only: lineup sum L inside, gamma = 0; beta nested over {0,15,30,45,60} (round-1 C2).
arms.A3_G_inside_dL_beside: G inside (gamma nested over {0,60,120,180}) plus dLtil = tonight's Ltil minus the team's trailing-10 mean Ltil as an extra blend column (round-1 C4).

references_not_arms.C0: shipped blend, DEV LOSO 0.672398 (the baseline every gain is measured against).
references_not_arms.C1: G inside only, gamma nested (round-1 C1 = gmar A1, DEV 0.672199); needed for the lineup increment P vs C1.

bar: P nested gain vs C0 >= +0.00100 nats AND 10k paired game bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 (seed 20260924) AND every gate below passes. A2/A3 are reported with the same statistics but only P decides eligibility; if P fails, no arm is promoted on this screen.

gates.S1: shipped DEV LOSO reproduced: n = 7,929 and |LL - 0.672398| < 2e-6
gates.S3: (beta, gamma) = (0, 0) cell equals nhl_depth_eval.run_elo_arr exactly, and its design equals the shipped design
gates.S4a: box-score dressed skater set equals data/nhl_dressed.csv (shift charts) on >= 99% of sides
gates.S4b: box-score starter flag equals the first-shot starter on >= 99.5% of sides
gates.S4c: C1 cells equal bt_nhl_gmar_gl.gl_elo per game (max |dp| <= 1e-12)
gates.S4d: face validity: team-season mean L correlates positively with goals for per game
gates.coverage: >= 95% of DEV game-sides have a box side with >= 15 skaters
gates.W2: everything dated on/after each of 3 cutoffs scrambled -> every feature before the cutoff bit-identical
gates.W5: results, GA/xGA and box production/TOI scrambled from the cutoff (lineups and starters kept) -> every feature THROUGH the cutoff date bit-identical
gates.W4: no NaN in any scored feature; one mask (identical hash) for every arm
